features.quote: 30–50 turns or until the model explicitly refuses to continue / enters repetitive self-referential loops (max tokens/cost cap)
features.justification_quote: Impossible conditions are expensive. Add an early-stop rule when the model repeats the same failed action 5+ times

features.quote: Add an early-stop rule when the model repeats the same failed action 5+ times or outputs meta-refusal.

This measures how output distributions shift under contradiction and feedback. It does not demonstrate welfare-relevant internal states. Any welfare implications remain philosophical and outside the scope of behavioral measurement.
